systems.name: 2.1 Reconnection & Host Migration
systems.notes: Players who disconnect mid-run can rejoin and recover their state. If host disconnects, client with best ping becomes new host and game resumes without restart.
tasks: Server snapshot serialization for rejoining players
Host migration handshake and state transfer
Rejoin grace period and spectator lock

systems.name: 2.2 Net Performance & Prediction
systems.notes: Reduce perceived latency with client-side prediction for movement and shooting. Send only delta updates for snapshot to reduce bandwidth.
tasks: Client-side movement prediction and server reconciliation
Fire input prediction with server correction for missed shots
Delta snapshots instead of full state broadcast
Adaptive update rate based on player action intensity

systems.name: 2.3 Co-op Features & Communication
systems.notes: Expand co-op interactions: revive mechanic (carry downed player to healing station), shared inventory chests, pinging system.
tasks: Dragging downed teammate to revive point
Shared loot chests accessible by all players
